rationale: Laravel already provides the stable application-owned logs-directory primitive through storage_path('logs'). All local file log channels resolve their laravel.log path beneath that directory. Adding a duplicate path-service wrapper would create dead abstraction rather than improve parity.
acceptance: canonical operation provenance is pinned to AIMW-OPER-55C6982761
single, daily, monthly, and emergency file channels share the stable Laravel logs directory
the directory is under the application storage root and is not caller-controlled
runtime can create, read, and remove a deterministic probe file inside the logs directory
